reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: The RGB and annual-change ratio should not be interpreted as a direct flood-depth or runoff-volume measurement.

criteria.name: local_precipitation_ledger
criteria.description: Computes local_total_mm as 486.5 and heavy_days_ge_50mm as 5.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for one correct local precipitation anchor.

criteria.name: antecedent_peak_split
criteria.description: Computes pre_peak_mm, peak_day_mm, antecedent_share, and peak_share with the requested rounding.

criteria.name: pre_peak_ratio
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for the correct numerator and denominator with a rounding error.

criteria.name: regional_mean
criteria.description: Computes regional_mean_mm as 210.4 from the three regional precipitation means.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for using only two regional means or rounding slightly outside the requested precision.

criteria.name: brightness_ratio
criteria.description: Computes bright_change_to_annual_change_ratio as 2.77 from unrounded paired-image bright fractions and unrounded annual change mean, then rounds the final ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for correct bright fractions but an incomplete ratio calculation.

criteria.name: arps_formula
criteria.description: Applies the ARPS formula and reports arps as 82.6.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-3 points for a formula attempt with one or two incorrect components.

criteria.name: json_contract
criteria.description: Returns concise JSON with the requested fields and numeric rounding. Full credit also requires the `reasoning_depth` object to identify decisive evidence, reject the main tempting simplification, and state a bounded uncertainty or scale caveat.
criteria.partial_credit: 0 points if the final answer is not machine-readable JSON.
